en.doc_auth.tips.header_text: Guidelines for taking a photo of your ID
en.doc_auth.tips.text1: Take it in a room with lots of light. Indirect sunlight is best.
en.doc_auth.tips.text2: Make sure your ID doesn't have dirt or damaged barcodes.
en.doc_auth.tips.text3: Place your ID on a dark solid-colored surface that makes it easy to see all edges of the ID.
en.doc_auth.tips.text4: Make sure there are no glares, shadows, or reflections on your ID.
en.doc_auth.tips.text5: Your ID should cover 80% of the photo.
en.doc_auth.tips.text6: Make sure the picture is sharp and clear. It should be easy to read all information.
en.doc_auth.tips.text7: Use a high-resolution camera. A good mobile phone or tablet camera will work.
